meta.name: context-window-design
meta.description: Designing around token limits, memory, and conversation persistence.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计对话上下文窗口，管理 token 限制与记忆
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在构建需要长对话记忆的 AI 应用
copy.tagline_en: Design conversation context windows, manage token limits and memory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if building AI apps that need long conversation memory

howto.what: 安装此技能后，Claude 在对话中会自动管理上下文窗口：对较早内容进行摘要压缩以释放 token，在 token 不足时优先保留重要上下文，并在上下文丢失时主动承认。
howto.when: 在对话过程中，当历史消息接近上下文窗口上限时，Claude 会自动启动摘要、优先级排序等策略。

say.text: 请总结我们之前聊过的内容。
say.note: 触发摘要压缩，释放 token 空间。

say.text: 优先记住我刚才说的那三点。
say.note: 调整优先级，确保关键信息不被丢弃。

say.text: 从我提供的文档中提取相关信息来补充对话。
say.note: 触发检索增强生成，导入外部上下文。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude automatically manages the context window: it compresses earlier conversation parts into summaries to free up tokens, prioritizes important context when tokens are low, and acknowledges when context is lost.
howto.when_en: During a conversation, when the history approaches the context window limit, Claude automatically triggers summarization, priority ordering, and other strategies.

say_en.text: Summarize what we've discussed so far.
say_en.note: Triggers compression to free up tokens.

say_en.text: Remember the three points I just made as top priority.
say_en.note: Adjusts priority to keep key info from being dropped.

say_en.text: Retrieve relevant information from my uploaded documents.
say_en.note: Triggers retrieval-augmented generation to bring in external context.
